purpose: Offline-derived candidates for <pool>/tasks/<task>/calibration-expectations.json. The runner schema is strict (exactly D1-D5, each exactly failing_test_title and reason_regex), so provenance lives here, not in the candidate files.
derivation: Titles: test names listed under 'reference result on mutant' in the task defects.md, choosing the test that exercises the 'valid detection' behavior; chain = Playwright JSON suite titles joined by ' > ' (file suite, describe, test). Reason regexes: the Playwright matcher name and locator string of the assertion in reference.spec.ts that the mutant breaks. No live run, patch application or model call was used.
pending_live_values: File-suite prefix 'reference.spec.ts > ' (depends on the scoring testDir; the first calibrate run records failing_test_titles in _scorer-calibration.json, owner then corrects the prefix)

Every reason_regex: real Playwright error message text for the mutant is unobserved; regexes are inferred from matcher/locator names (D3 rename uses an alternation because which assertion fires first is unobserved)
Whether each chosen test is the one that actually fails on its mutant under the OSS scoring path
owner_action: Copy each candidate to <pool>/tasks/<task>/calibration-expectations.json only after reviewing it; the pool task directory digest is a freeze binding, so copy before freeze. Acceptance requires a live `calibrate` PASS; a failed calibration authorizes no data calls.
